classification: Independent public-source architecture assessment; private correspondence excluded

sources.title: CESMII technology and three imperatives
sources.finding: CESMII places SM Profiles, contextual information platforms, and a common API underneath reusable manufacturing applications. Its stated problem is repeated rediscovery of data, context and integration.

sources.title: CESMII ProveIt 2026 live demonstration
sources.finding: Partners demonstrated live interoperability across platforms and an external client. Match that discover, connect, consume workflow; add a correction and independent handoff test.

sources.title: i3X 1.0 Implementation Guide
sources.finding: Explore, current/history query and subscription sync form a defined contract. Updates and streaming are optional. Production authentication is required, but the scheme is implementation-specific. A data API does not by itself certify a business decision.

sources.title: Official i3X conformance harness
sources.finding: CESMII already supplies executable compliance tests. This lab tests application-level retention and replay separately; it does not award i3X compliance.

sources.title: Official public demo and demo limitations
sources.finding: The demo illustrates API patterns and relationships and explicitly excludes production suitability. Its values, including Good-quality readings, must not be represented as physical measurements.

sources.title: Public i3X API documentation
sources.finding: The read-only collector retains raw responses, quality flags, request bodies, source URLs and capture timestamps. GoodNoData and null remain unknown.

sources.title: i3X developer FAQ
sources.finding: i3X deliberately simplifies richer industrial interfaces. Existing platforms may already implement orchestration, history and audit; a blanket claim that the ecosystem lacks them would exceed the evidence.

sources.title: CESMII Smart Manufacturing Catalog
sources.finding: Customer discovery runs through products, demonstrations and developer resources grouped by the three imperatives. This proof is packaged as a portable application demonstration, not a replacement platform.

sources.title: CESMII project portfolio
sources.finding: Published application areas include maintenance, quality, energy productivity, traceability and supply-chain optimization. These establish relevance, not demand for AXM or measured commercial upside.

sources.title: John Dyck, CESMII CEO
sources.finding: Executive relevance: portable capability, adoption and manufacturing outcomes. The public biography emphasizes operational and supply-chain transformation.

sources.title: Jonathan Wise, chief technology architect
sources.finding: Technical relevance: existing platform contracts, information models and implementation semantics. The useful review is an executable boundary test.

sources.title: Existing AXM Team Commons source
sources.finding: The existing synthetic three-team engine handles missing evidence, contribution hashes, explicit correction lineage and recomputed handoff. This lab reuses its exact source and adds an i3X evidence binding.

claims.text: Information models, contextual graph access, common data operations, client tooling and conformance machinery. Preserve these rather than rebuilding or claiming them as AXM inventions.
Portability, composability, interoperable information, reusable applications and vendor independence. Shared vocabulary establishes fit; it does not establish equivalent implementations.

Keep exact decision inputs, correction lineage and the recipe with the result. On a fresh client, verify sources and recompute earlier and corrected conclusions without the originating chat or operator.

A vendor MES, historian or orchestration product may already provide this inside its boundary. The differentiating test is whether an independent recipient can replay the same decision outside that vendor with the complete evidence and recipe. Comparative vendor testing remains open.

i3X sync can recover subscription data subject to its retention and loss rules. AXM must demonstrate preservation of a decision's reasons and obligations, not relabel subscription recovery as a missing standard feature.

Read-only API capture plus synthetic organizational records. No real tenant isolation, identity verification, physical inspection, production writeback, cross-vendor deployment, savings or CESMII endorsement has been established.

priority.scale: 0 absent; 1 plausible; 2 fixture-supported or indirect fit; 3 direct fit or implemented path. Analyst prioritization, not customer measurements or ROI.

golden.title: Pump repair and spare-part readiness
golden.reason: A pump exists in the official demo, the existing AXM exercise already joins maintenance, inventory and allocation, and one correction yields a visibly different conclusion that another client can recompute.

expansion.next: Bind an approved second endpoint without changing the decision recipe.
Add a customer-owned freshness policy and process-specific units.
Use an owned sandbox and explicit write authority; retain proposed and actual effects separately.
Run the official harness on an owned sandbox, then bind loss signals to application uncertainty.
Bind actual identities, access controls and release approvals without treating a hash as authentication.
Agree a baseline, business metric, observation window and independent acceptance before making benefit claims.
